s1.desc: a dim bedroom with a bed and a nightstand, drawn on a plain grey background

spans.notes: a rose chat-message bubble with text pops in at the top of the picture at f10 and stays to the end of the shot (f10-43); f0-9 are clean but only 10 frames. Pax sits at a sushi bar counter with plates of sushi, soy sauce and a phone, picks up the phone and reads it. Slow push-in through the whole shot (ECC on the counter band: scale 1.010 at f10, 1.023 f20, 1.036 f30, 1.047 f40)

chat-message bubble with text at the top from f56 to the end of the shot (f56-109); f44-55 clean but only 12 frames. Pax sits on a cream sofa behind a tray of sushi, eats and then holds a phone. Slow push-in through the whole shot (ECC on the floor band: scale 1.020 at f60 to 1.079 at f108)

chat-message bubbles with text at the top from f115 to the end of the shot (a second reply bubble from ~f150); f110-114 show only the shower curtain, no lead. Pax peeks out from behind a shower curtain next to a bathroom sink and reads a phone. Push-in through the shot (ECC scale 1.037 at f125 to 1.155 at f170, low cc because Pax moves through the band)

chat-message bubble with text at the top from f181 to the end of the shot (f181-213); f172-180 clean but only 9 frames. Pax lies in bed in a lamplit room, typing on a phone. Slow push-in through the shot (ECC scale 1.012 at f182 to 1.049 at f212)

spans.view: with a lamp and a phone on the nightstand

beats.text: Pax sleeps soundly on his side under the covers, his head on the pillow and his eyes closed

spans.notes: slow steady push-in from the cut: ECC on the nightstand band (cols 0-35%) scale 1.0044, 1.0082, 1.0133, 1.0173, 1.0218 every 6 frames from f214, no static run; compare 214/240 shows doubled bed edges. Night: the whole room is drawn in dim greyed colours. Clean of bubbles until f240 (equalised top third / bottom fifth scan every 4 frames). The phone lies face down on the nightstand showing a grey back with a lens cluster and a small tuft, likely the iFin but small and dim: not named in the beat

a chat-message bubble with text pops in at the top at f241, a second one with a heart from ~f262, both to the end (f241-324). Pax keeps sleeping and smiles with blush marks. The push-in continues to the end (ECC scale 1.025 at f250 to 1.078 at f322 vs f214)
